about: Questions a learner might ask, and what a right answer cites. 'expect' lists words of which at least one must be in the title (or, for jobs, the page) of a cited source. 'refuse' means the answer must cite nothing and say it is not in the course. Run: python server/evaluate.py (offline) or python server/evaluate.py --cloud (with the AI).
